task.title: Remove dead stale_claim_recovery_seconds config field
task.description:
After task 905 switched release_stale_claims to cutoff=0 at startup, `stale_claim_recovery_seconds` in fused-memory/src/fused_memory/config/schema.py:290-297 is unused in production code. Only references left are the field definition and assertions in tests/test_config_schema.py on the default. Operators tuning it will see no effect, and the docstring still claims it controls the startup release horizon.

Preferred fix: delete the field from ReconciliationConfig and drop the corresponding assertions in tests/test_config_schema.py. If a future periodic-sweep feature needs it, reintroduce at that time rather than carrying dead config now.

Alternative: repurpose the docstring to make clear the field is reserved for future use (in-loop periodic sweeps) and no longer gates startup behavior.

Source: reviewer_comprehensive suggestion on task 905 (merge 6a12f7b0cf).
